rules.statement: A Buddhist priest can be deprived of, or can free himself from, the character, or status, or quality of a priest.
rules.supporting_quote: "With respect to the 2nd defendant, all that it is necessary to say is that he claims the right of succession to Rewata by deed, said to have been executed after Rewata had been found guilty by the ecclesiastical tribunal, which deed however he does not produce. I agree with the learned Judge's conclusion as to the value of that deed."
